quotes.quote: Security is a process, not a product.
quotes.author: Bruce Schneier

quotes.quote: If someone steals your password, you can change it. But if someone steals your thumbprint, you can't get a new thumb.
quotes.author: Bruce Schneier

quotes.quote: People often represent the weakest link in the security chain and are chronically responsible for the failure of security systems.
quotes.author: Bruce Schneier

quotes.quote: The more we expect technology to protect us from people, the more we will sacrifice the very values of our society in futile attempts to achieve this security.
quotes.author: Bruce Schneier

quotes.quote: Companies spend millions of dollars on firewalls, encryption, and secure access devices, and it's money wasted, because none of these measures address the weakest link in the security chain.
quotes.author: Kevin Mitnick

quotes.quote: The weakest link in the security chain is the human element.
quotes.author: Kevin Mitnick

quotes.quote: Never underestimate the determination of a kid who is time-rich and cash-poor.
quotes.author: Cory Doctorow

quotes.quote: It's not that uncommon for the cost of an abstraction to outweigh the benefit it delivers. Kill one today.
quotes.author: John Carmack

quotes.quote: One of the big lessons of a big project is you don't want people that aren't really programmers programming; you'll suffer for it.
quotes.author: John Carmack

quotes.quote: Because of the nature of Moore's law, anything that an extremely clever graphics programmer can do at one point can be replicated by a merely competent programmer some number of years later.
quotes.author: John Carmack

quotes.quote: Sharing the code just seems like the right thing to do. It costs us rather little, but it benefits a lot of people in sometimes very significant ways.
quotes.author: John Carmack

quotes.quote: The best programmers are not necessarily the ones who can write the most code or the most clever code, but the ones who can communicate the most effectively.
quotes.author: John Carmack

quotes.quote: Focused, hard work is the real key to success.
quotes.author: John Carmack

quotes.quote: Low level programming is good for the programmer's soul.
quotes.author: John Carmack

quotes.quote: I surprised myself. I thought I'll never be able to compete with these guys like John Carmack, but once I started building the Unreal editor, it turned out I was actually pretty good at that.
quotes.author: Tim Sweeney

quotes.quote: Our motto was: bite off more than we could chew, then figure out some crazy complicated way to make it work.
quotes.author: Patrick Wyatt

quotes.quote: Internal criticism is essential. Iteration is king.
quotes.author: Patrick Wyatt

quotes.quote: Trees sprout up just about everywhere in computer science.
quotes.author: Donald Knuth

quotes.quote: The process of preparing programs for a digital computer is especially attractive because it can be an aesthetic experience much like composing poetry or music.
quotes.author: Donald Knuth

quotes.quote: Science is knowledge which we understand so well that we can teach it to a computer; if we don't fully understand something, it is an art to deal with it.
quotes.author: Donald Knuth

quotes.quote: Programmers waste enormous amounts of time thinking about the speed of noncritical parts of their programs.
quotes.author: Donald Knuth

quotes.quote: If you optimize everything, you will always be unhappy.
quotes.author: Donald Knuth

quotes.quote: Computers are good at following instructions, but not at reading your mind.
quotes.author: Donald Knuth

quotes.quote: I decry the current tendency to seek patents on algorithms.
quotes.author: Donald Knuth

quotes.quote: The curse of dimensionality describes the overwhelming computational complexity associated with the solution of multi-stage decision processes through dynamic programming.
quotes.author: Richard Bellman

quotes.quote: Data dominates. If you've chosen the right data structures and organized things well, the algorithms will almost always be self-evident.
quotes.author: Rob Pike

quotes.quote: Data structures, not algorithms, are central to programming.
quotes.author: Rob Pike

quotes.quote: The task of composition of operations is often considered the heart of the art of programming; however, the appropriate composition of data is equally fundamental and essential.
quotes.author: Niklaus Wirth

quotes.quote: In algorithms, as in life, persistence usually pays off.
quotes.author: Steven Skiena

quotes.quote: Problem-solving is not a science, but part art and part skill. It is one of the skills most worth developing.
quotes.author: Steven Skiena

quotes.quote: The issue of finding the best possible answer or achieving maximum efficiency usually arises in industry only after serious performance or legal troubles.
quotes.author: Steven Skiena

quotes.quote: To understand recursion, one must first understand recursion.
quotes.author: classic computer science aphorism, origin disputed

quotes.quote: The collective failure by many talented people to find efficient algorithms for specific NP-complete problems strongly suggests that no efficient algorithm exists for any of them.
quotes.author: Richard Karp, in the framing of his Turing Award citation
